facts.fact: Le Chiffre d'Affaires reports that a national cybersecurity strategy for 2025-2029 has been adopted by the National Council for the Security of Information Systems, as stated at the 12 May 2025 unveiling of the digital strategy.

systems.system: Centre National Algérien des Services Numériques (two national data centres)

DZA.note: Two national data centres are being created; none stated in service or for hire.

facts.fact: Le Chiffre d'Affaires reports that a national interoperability platform is among projects that have 'already' emerged under the governance pillar of the digital strategy unveiled on 12 May 2025; no bodies connected or use are stated.

The High Commissioner for Digitalisation, Meriem Benmouloud, unveiled the national digital transformation strategy 'Pour une Algérie numérique 2030' on 12 May 2025 at a ceremony under the patronage of President Tebboune, in five axes and 25 strategic objectives.
The strategy's 25 objectives are to be reached between 2025 and 2030, according to Le Chiffre d'Affaires.
The High Commission for Digitalisation, placed directly under the Presidency, is charged with steering and coordinating the strategic digital transformation projects.
Implementation rests on sectoral action plans validated for 2025-2026, per Le Chiffre d'Affaires; no costs are given.

DZA.note: Citizen participation is named as an aim; no online consultation stated.
Nothing on government payments to people.
Data centres to international norms is an aim only; no standard adopted.

facts.fact: Le Chiffre d'Affaires reports the digital strategy unveiled on 12 May 2025 as the result of broad consultation with ministries, experts, economic operators and digital actors.
